caseName: Michigan ex rel. Groesbeck v. Detroit United Railway
caseNameFull: People of the State of Michigan ex rel. Alex. J. Groesbeck, Attorney General, etc. v. Detroit United Railway
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Michigan.
attorneys: -Mr. Merlin Wiley, Mr. Clare Raton and Mr. Sheridan F. Master for plaintiff in error., Mr. Elliott G. Stevenson and Mr. William L. Carpenter for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
